Deterministic vs Stochastic
stochastic implies uncertainty about outcomes is expressed through
probabilities
non deterministic implies actions are by possible outcomes
might be through performance measure
Episodic vs. Sequential
agent’s experience is divided into atomic episodes
each episode consists of the agent perceiving and
then performing action
independent of previous action
classification tasks are episodic
episodic environments are simpler in all senses
needs no planning
Sequential
current decision would affect all future decisions
can have long-term consequences
chess and driving are sequential
